project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier serverless architecture with distinct trust boundaries: User-facing frontend connects through API Gateway to backend AI/ML processing layer. Authentication handled via Amazon Cognito. Web Application Firewall (WAF) provides perimeter protection. Data flows through API Gateway to Lambda functions which interact with vector database (OpenSearch) and LLM services (Bedrock). Six distinct trust boundaries identified: Users, Authentication, API Gateway, Content Moderation Policies, Knowledge Base, and AI/ML Processing (Model, LLM Connect, Agents).
key_components: AWS Lambda (Data Processing and Embedding Generation)
Amazon Bedrock Titan Embedding Model (RAG Embeddings)
Bedrock Guardrails (Content Moderation and PII Redaction)
